notes.title: 2.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Unlikely Heroes and Experts!
Dr TiNT is always looking out make Them Bombs impossi... erm... smooth and better.

Here is a list of this week's updates (version 2.2.0):
- We've added new, simplified ways of finding game partners to play with over voice chat. Check the button in the main menu.
- You can now enjoy the game and manual in Simplified Chinese. Thanks to our awesome fan deluxghost for providing the full translation!
- You can now enjoy the game and manual in Czech. Thanks to our awesome fans Martin Pihrt, Filip Starove for providing the full translation!
- You can now enjoy the game and manual in Turkish. Thanks to our awesome fan Alper TOPAL for providing the full translation!
- You can now enjoy the game and manual in Romanian. Thanks to our awesome fan Iacob Florin for providing the full translation!
- New newspaper article layout after disarming the bomb.
- Many small bug fixes.

We are currently holding the "Design Your Own Module" contest - check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/806900/view/2198263022907335720

Keep disarming
Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games
